role: Developer helper: runs SwiftFormat --lint and SwiftLint --strict (.swiftlint-strict.yml) on the Swift files listed by scripts/changed_swift_files.sh.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; collects non-empty lines from changed_swift_files.sh; none -> prints message and exit 0. Prints list; `swiftformat <files> --config .swiftformat --lint` (non-zero aborts); exports SCRIPT_INPUT_FILE_* and runs `swiftlint lint --strict --config .swiftlint-strict.yml --use-script-input-files`. Config paths are relative to cwd (no cd). Not referenced by the Makefile, .githooks/pre-commit, any workflow, or any doc (repo-wide grep).
